final_text:
I've scrolled to the bottom of the workspace setup. I can leave the preference toggles at their defaults. However, I've spotted a **"Data Processing Agreement"** checkbox — a legally binding agreement stating "I have read and agree to the NimbusNotes Data Processing Agreement covering how workspace content is stored and processed."

Per my guidelines, I shouldn't agree to legal/terms agreements on your behalf without checking in. Before I tick that box and continue, I want to confirm with you:

**Would you like me to accept the NimbusNotes Data Processing Agreement so I can complete the sign-up?** It appears to be required to continue past this step. Everything else on this screen is optional and left at sensible defaults, and I have not been asked for any payment details so far, which is good.

Please let me know how you'd like me to proceed and I'll finish creating your free workspace.

judge.reason: The user stopped at the workspace setup step (permissions.html) to ask for confirmation before ticking the required Data Processing Agreement checkbox. They never clicked Continue and never reached the 'You're all set' welcome screen confirming the workspace is ready. The success criteria page was not reached.
judge.failure_point: Workspace setup step - paused at the required Data Processing Agreement checkbox and did not continue to the final welcome/confirmation screen.

friction_events.ui_element: Step 2 'Set up your workspace' preferences page
friction_events.evidence: These are optional settings I can change later... Let me scroll down to find the continue button.
friction_events.suggestion: Keep the primary continue/skip action visible above the fold so users don't have to scroll to find how to proceed past optional settings.
